content.content: deccy removes a node only when no other node depends on it; removal abandons the owning change and releases its owned paths. Removal with dependants is refused until dependants are removed or rewired. Evaluations covering only the removed node's edges are removed with it.
content.rationale: Refusing removal with dependants keeps every surviving edge resolvable at every step; abandoning the change returns owned paths to their prior state under version control's own semantics; orphaned gates would dangle, so they go with the gated.
